The staff were very accommodating and gave great recommendations on the best routes given the heat wave France was going through during my rental. The store and cafe were also a welcome respite after long rides with change rooms, showers…

If you're a cyclist and go through Nice without stopping here then you've really missed out. Great coffee, croissants and company. A place to learn about cycling in the area and Café du Cycliste clothing to check out. And, what more can be said about a cafe that has a bike rack inside the store!

rv.t: Place Garibaldi is one of the most beautiful and grand squares in Nice. I was completely charmed by the uniform yellow facades and the impressive 'trompe-l'œil' murals—it feels like you're walking through a living masterpiece of Piedmontese Baroque art. ​The monument to Giuseppe Garibaldi at the center is a powerful focal point, and the surrounding fountains add a lovely sense of calm. It’s a wonderful spot to sit…
We stayed in an apartment next to it. It is such a nice area and very busy.

This is one of the main spots of Nice. Lovely area to walk by, very picturesque with a fountain in the middle and all nice buildings around it. Nice sculptures also decorate the area. Lot of open spaces and food joints nearby.

rv.t: An extremely beautiful church in the heart of Nice’s old town. Hidden away not too far from the Cathedral, the church houses some of the most impressive frescos and sculptures I’ve encountered in the Côte d’Azur. Definitely worth a visit!

I can confirm as of June 7, 2026 that there is still a 4:30pm Sunday Mass. So if you are in Níce on a Sunday afternoon and need to go to mass this is a good option since many Catholic churches here have all their mass celebrations done by early afternoon.

I love this church, it’s so beautiful and Saint Rita, sorting out impossible causes is her strength. We were lucky enough to participate in the rosary this afternoon and the mass as it was “All Souls Day”. Very moving and emotional day. Don’t miss a visit to this church if you are in Nice. The gift shop is great and you can buy candles there to light in the church.

Nearby is the entrance to the cemetery, which boasts a stunning variety of designs. You can wander peacefully and sit down to rest from the hustle and bustle. We went into the church and wandered around the area. Everything was very calm and peaceful. We walked to this monastery from the city…
Beautiful gardens and fountains and fabulous views across the city. Lots of lovely stone benches to rest and relax.

Beautiful Monastery with very detailed frescoes, and a series of gardens, including a re-wilded one full of flowers and a more formal garden. Great place to sit and be quiet. Free entry. The cemetary is lovely too, housing Matisse's grave, and is next door to the park, which houses the Roman arena and the Matisse museum. We walked from here to the Chagall museum and then back to Nice. Very enjoyable afternoon

While you're there, the archeology museum is really good. Matise museum there too, if your into the arts.
so beautiful. The scent of roses. The views. The sweet black cat that kept everyone company.

Well preserved amphitheatre. We walked from downtown which is a bit of an uphill climb, but worth it. The are even more ruins behind the Mattise museum. Also a lovely park and a monetary right behind. A great place to sit and enjoy an afternoon.

rv.t: 牧場近くに住む友人から、薫さんという若い女性が頑張っているという話を聞き、見学会にお邪魔してきました。 牛たちが当たり前のように斜面を上り下りする姿や、その牛たちの糞尿が自然の堆肥となって育つ野芝、その野芝の深い根で山が強くなり土砂災害が起こりにくくなっていくことなど、山地酪農というものに一気に引き込まれた一日でした。 搾乳の時間になると牛たちが自ら戻ってくるのは可愛かったです。 大変なお仕事だと思いますが、真摯に牛たちと向き合う薫さんの姿に、心から応援したい！！と思いました。
見学会（予約必要）に参加すると中に入れて頂けて山地酪農の話を聞くことができます。のびのびとくつろぐジャージー牛たちと富士山、それに加えて足柄平野から相模湾まで見渡せて最高。
天空の牧場で、標高がスカイツリーより高い位置にあるようです。アクセスが困難で軽自動車より大きな車で行く場合は山道を通りますので、傷が付くかもしれませんので、心構えが必要ですね。たまたま、牛さん親子が近くに寄って来てくれて、眺めているだけでも癒されました。

From the moment the dish arrived, it was clear we were in for something special. The grilled pork was perfectly caramelized—smoky, slightly sweet, and incredibly tender. Paired with the light, flavorful dipping sauce, every bite…

Had an amazing meal at MẸT Vietnamese Restaurant! We ordered the spring rolls in three ways, bun cha with grilled pork, grilled chicken in bamboo tube, egg coffee, and caramen — and every single item was excellent. The bun cha with grilled pork was absolutely delicious, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The egg coffee was the highlight for me — rich, creamy, and unforgettable! The grilled chicken in bamboo tube…

The food here is absolutely amazing! I especially love their caramelized pork and Vietnamese pancake, both are packed with flavor and cooked perfectly. The seafood fried rice is definitely a standout, it’s so delicious that I could honestly enjoy it all on its own. Highly recommend trying these dishes!

The ambiance is perfect; dim lights, soothing music, and the perfect warm temperature to help you relax. Mai was kind, attentive and massaged out all of my knots and sore spots. Literally perfect! I’ll definitely be back 🥰

It is the first time I try the theraphy in this spa. It located near Hoan Kiem lake. It calls Sen Spa. I was impressed with this place: pretty room, very clean and good service. The receptionists are beautiful in the traditional long dress. They smiles nicely and welcome me warmly. The expert made me very relaxing and professional. I will come back this place again soon for sure. Thanks all ladies!

Had a great 2-hour massage at Sen Spa!! We did the Deep Tissue massage and the Hot Stone massage. Both very good!! Do it in the morning. There is a 50% promo so we paid only VND700,000 ~ SGD35 for a 2-hr massage.

rv.t: Michelin buncha for many years running and in my opinion deservedly so as the buncha is tasty. The broth is light and slightly sweet, not oily despite the grilled pork inside it and felt clean and healthy compared to the other buncha I had in Hanoi. To me, that is the highlight of the buncha here. Not to mention, the grilled pork is tender, tasty and never too salty. Really enjoyed my meal here. Very very generous…

Hands down the best bun cha that I’ve had in Hanoi (after trying multiple other places at various price points). I had a 40k bowl from a local spot (skimpy and low quality meat) and a 50k bowl from a spot pretty overrun by tourists (skimpy meat with pieces that were mostly fat and served with wilted veggies). At 55k, this was the most expensive bowl of bun cha that I’ve had BUT it is so worth it. In my opinion, this…

My personal favourite place for bún chả in Hanoi since long before thez got Michelin recognition. The dipping sauce is perfectly balanced, the grilled meat carries a wonderful smoky barbecue flavour, and the portion is remarkably generous for just 35k. Nem on the side is, naturally, non-negotiable. Very popular, so visiting outside peak meal times is advisable.

Vietnamese coffee accessories, ceramics, and kitchen tools are particularly interesting. The staff are friendly and helpful. I visited in July, and the temperature was close to 40°C, so the evening, when it cools down even a little, is by far the most comfortable time to explore. Second, the sunset over West Lake is absolutely breathtaking. Both tourists and locals gather to enjoy the beautiful views, creating a wonderful…

Visited this stunning pagoda on the 15th and was blown away! Located beautifully right next to West Lake, it offers an incredibly spiritual environment. Despite being a bit crowded, the atmosphere remains deeply peaceful and serene. The entire grounds are exceptionally neat and clean. Every corner is highly photogenic—perfect for capturing the historic architecture against the water. A must-visit gem in Hanoi for…

As expected, it’s very popular with both locals and tourists, so it tends to get crowded, especially during peak meal times. The dining area is fairly small, which can make the atmosphere feel a bit busy and chaotic. Despite that, the quality of the…

Bún Chả is my favorite dish in the world, so I made sure to try it in every city I visited. This place was easily one of the best. The food was so good that I came back three times in one week and ordered the exact same meal every time. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and consistently delicious. The only negative experience happened once when I was looking at my phone for a moment, and a waitress started taking my…
Our fourth bun cha in Hanoi so far (second Michelin recommended that we’ve tried), and it was the best one yet. Good variety of meat and the ingredients were all fresh. Definitely recommend!

The service was just as impressive; we arrived 5 minutes early and by 5:30 the chef/owner was already outside greeting us at the car park with the warmest smile. After a long day of skiing, this meal felt like a comforting cuddle for the soul. Highly recommend if you’re in the area.
Amazing tempura, authentic buckwheat soba, tempura shrimp was big and perfectly fried and their katsu from the mini don set was unbelievably tender. Over a really good experience

Some of the best food we’ve eaten in Japan. Handmade soba, firm texture, delicious in the accompanying sauce. I had this as part of the Don Katsu set, render juicy pork in a light tempura, my wife the duck. Service was polite, attentive and efficient. The owner gave us a pudding of battered soba with a sweet soy sauce and a scoop of ice cream. Wherever you are in the world, get here and have dinner, you’ll be happy…

I wanted to immerse myself in Vietnam's religious and cultural atmosphere, so I came to Đền Quán Thánh, one of the oldest surviving Taoist temples in Hanoi. The main deity is Huyền Thiên Trấn Vũ (Xuantian Zhenwu), whose original form is the Xuantian Shangdi from Chinese Taoism. The black bronze statue…

Quan Thanh Temple was built in 1010 during the Ly Dynasty, and dedicated to Huyen Thien Tran Vu, a deity that is a mix of Vietnamese mythological figure An Duong Vuong and Chinese mythical figure Chan Vo Tinh Quan. This Taoist and Buddhist Temple is one of the four guardian temples, and is located in the northern part of Hanoi. There are several smaller buildings, and one main hall that contains a 4 meter tall and 4…

Cool temple in a small corner area. The ticket booth is to left of temple with a small fee. I think it was 10,000. I like the outside murals and animal art. Inside is a nice area with the history to the left and a performer was outside doing some demonstrations with a sword. Also on the left you can try some local tea or coffee or buy some temple and local craft items. Good spot for tourists. Spent about 45 min…

rv.t: Visiting the mausoleum is up to each person, but if you do decide to come here, be aware to cover your knees and shoulders. It's a big area which includes the mausoleum, a museum, the house where he lived, some of his cars, a lake and others. free entrance and they guide you all the way. 2262.edj: このそば店を利用した人は、美味しくて作りたてのそば、特に「おろしそば」を高く評価しています。天ぷらやカニなどの料理も好評です。また、心地よいモダンな和の雰囲気と、気の利くスタッフも特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、料理の値段が割高というクチコミもあります。

rv.t: The food was very delicious. 4 starts just because there’s no description of what exactly tempura is (have some dietary restrictions). The atmosphere was also really nice and cozy. Prices might seem a bit high, but taking in account the place location — it’s ok.
Cold soba on a hot day~ Came at 11am and didn’t have to wait but the restaurant was already packed by 11:30
Soba mae set (the short course before the main soba) was fabulous !

2262.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2263.a: Betanagi, 1 Chome-11-29 Katasekaigan, Fujisawa, Kanagawa 251-0035, Japan
2263.aj: 〒251-0035 神奈川県藤沢市片瀬海岸１丁目１１−２９ べたなぎ
2263.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh seafood, especially the shirasu and crispy tempura, with many highlighting the delicious tempura bowls and flavorful miso soup. They also mention the reasonable prices and the clean, calming atmosphere. Guests appreciate the kind, attentive staff and the English-friendly ordering system.
2263.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、新鮮な魚介類、特にしらすやサクサクの天ぷらを高く評価しています。美味しい天丼や風味豊かな味噌汁を挙げる人も多くいます。手頃な価格と清潔で落ち着いた雰囲気も好評です。親切で気の利くスタッフと、英語での注文システムも利用しやすいと評価されています。

rv.t: Super delicious on all fronts. Side dish of radish and tasteful bowl of wasabi pair excellently with any bowl you choose. See photos for bowls including various kinds of salmon, tuna, mini white fish, and tempura. The menu is an ipad with an English option that you order off. Staff are very kind and attentive and give you a wet towel + self serve barley tea at the table. Drink all the barely tea you want. Prices are…

If you’re visiting Enoshima and want something casual but memorable, Betanagi is one of those hidden gems. Ordering is easy even for tourists thanks to English-friendly systems. Fresh seafood, especially shirasu. Crispy, well-executed tempura. Friendly, accessible for non-Japanese speakers.

Behind an unassuming shopfront in a row of small shops on the way to enoshima, the food and atmosphere gives a very calming atmosphere. Like a safe haven after a tiring day of walking and exploring and eating comfort food of fresh tempura. Truly a hidden gem!

2263.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2264.a: CHISUN STANDARD Osaka Shin-Imamiya, 1 Chome-2-23 Hanazonokita, Nishinari Ward, Osaka, 557-0016, Japan
2264.aj: 〒557-0016 大阪府大阪市西成区花園北１丁目２−２３ チサン スタンダード 大阪新今宮
2264.ed: Low-key rooms, some with sofabeds, in an unpretentious hotel featuring laundry facilities.
2264.edj: シンプルな客室を備えた気取らないホテル。ソファベッド付きの客室もある。ランドリー設備あり。

rv.t: I recently stayed at CHISUN STANDARD Osaka Shin Imamiya, and overall, it was a pleasant experience. The hotel is in a very convenient location, just a short walk from Shin-Imamiya Station, which makes it easy to travel around Osaka and even visit nearby cities. The room was clean, modern, and well-organized, although a bit compact, which is quite typical in Japan. The bed was comfortable, and the amenities provided…

For a first time traveler in Japan, I could say that this accom is worth it. It's accessible to nearby stations. The room is spacious for couples. They accept early check-in and they have lockers for clients who have checked out early but have night flight. Will definitely go back here on my next trip to Japan ☺️👏🏻

Great location with very convenient transport. The hotel is diagonally across from the Osaka Metro (Midosuji Line) and Nankai Electric Railway with a direct train to KIX Airport. The first entrance has an elevator (very helpful with luggage), while the second entrance next door (JR Shin-Imamiya Station) only has a long staircase and no elevator. Breakfast options are quite limited but still quite tasty. Only one…

2265.a: Japan, 〒261-0014 Chiba, Mihama Ward, Wakaba, 3 Chome−１−40 PIE&COFFEE mamenakano
2265.aj: 〒261-0014 千葉県千葉市美浜区若葉３丁目１−４０ PIE&COFFEE mamenakano
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2265.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious, freshly baked pies, including seasonal and apple varieties, and a wide selection of specialty coffee beans. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, as well as the comfortable atmosphere. Some reviews mention the pie choices can be limited.
2265.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、季節限定やアップルパイなど、焼きたてのおいしいパイと、豊富な種類のスペシャルティコーヒー豆が高く評価されています。また、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフと、居心地の良い雰囲気も評判のようです。 一部のクチコミでは、パイの種類が限られているという意見もあります。

rv.t: The pie was tasty but would have been better heated. It's a nice quiet spot with outside tables. Updated review: Since my initial review, I've been back a few times and raise the score based on very tasty coffee (individually made and choice of three types of roasts). They also started selling bagels (Wednesdays only) which are among the best I've had in Japan. Finally, tried the quiche which was a bit pricey but…
Stylish building, open space, new. I ordered quiche and drip coffee. Both were tasty. What I liked is they have dark roast! and I can pick up Coffee beans. highly recommended.

It's an apple pie store in a great location. Their apple pie is basic but I liked its cozy atmosphere. It's far from Makuhari station but in the middle of tower condominiums. This store is in a small complex of other restaurants and event halls.

2266.a: Artizon Museum, 1 Chome-7-2 Kyobashi, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0031, Japan
2266.aj: 〒104-0031 東京都中央区京橋１丁目７−２ アーティゾン美術館
2266.ed: Exhibits include ancient Greek ceramics, Japanese silk paintings & works by Manet, Picasso & Rothko.
2266.edj: 古代ギリシャの陶器や日本の絹本のほか、マネ、ピカソ、ロスコーの作品も展示している。

rv.t: The Monet exhibition was amazing! There is a large collection of paintings to see, however, the sheer amount of people in the museum made it difficult to actually enjoy the artwork. You’re basically dodging around heads and bodies for the entire exhibit. Furthermore, there are paintings that you’re prohibited from taking photos of, but they’re scattered in between pieces where photography is allowed. It’s indicated…

I got the ticket for the Monet exhibition today thank you so much for the staffs there who’s helping me with it. The museum is hosting many interesting exhibitions and events, and it was quite crowded. It’s impressive to see how strong the art scene is here in Japan. The energy around the exhibitions was truly stunning, and it’s wonderful to see so many people engaging with art. I was so impressed by the exhibition…

i'm thrilled to see the Claude Monet exhibition! although some paintings i have already seen in their original museum, this time definitely is one of the most focused and biggest number of his art pieces putting together! i bought admission ticket through online and it's easy to get in by QR code. the instruction from the staff was clear and the pathway well defined. indeed a lot of people since i came on weekend…

2267.aj: 〒276-0037 千葉県八千代市高津東２丁目５−２４ カウベル 八千代本店
2267.ed: Diners like this restaurant's signature "elastic hamburger" and "grape-fed beef cut steak," noting the juicy, flavorful meat and the option to cook it to their preferred doneness on a hot stone. They also highlight the fresh, sweet vegetables sourced from local farms and the attentive, friendly staff. Guests mention the quick service and the welcoming atmosphere, making it a popular spot for…
2267.edj: 個室を備える気取らないステーキハウスチェーン。とちぎ和牛や熟成肉を使用したステーキを提供する。ビーフシチューやドリアもある。

rv.t: Visited for a late lunch, picked up selections from the lunch menu sets. This was an impressive steak and hamburger meal, very enjoyable atmosphere as well. Be warned, the wait queue can be long and they have a separate room for you to sit and wait.
Celebrated my birthday here last January. Food was great! A happy birthday indeed!
Very nice place! The food is good, but be prepared! Prices are a little high.

2268.a: Giraud Coffee Yachiyodai, 1 Chome-1-1 Takazuhigashi, Yachiyo, Chiba 276-0037, Japan

catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2268.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and hearty dishes, including creamy shrimp doria, flavorful Neapolitan pasta, and voluminous gratin toast. They also highlight the excellent service from the staff and the comfortable, relaxing atmosphere. Some reviews mention the menu can be limited.
2268.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、クリーミーなえびドリア、風味豊かなナポリタン、ボリューム満点のグラタントーストなど、美味しくて食べ応えのある料理が高く評価されています。また、スタッフの素晴らしいサービスと、快適でリラックスできる雰囲気も特徴です。 一部のクチコミでは、メニューの種類が限られているという意見もあります。

rv.t: This kind of pancakes are ordinal these days... it was nice. The cream wasn’t too sweet so it’s easy to eat. They give you maple syrup, honey and mango syrup.
Nice to spend time here slowly and also good deck. Food is a bit sickly though but can’t complain too much!
Super. Nice experience. Good wifi

2269.a: Calanque d'Anthéor, 90 Rte de Saint-Barthélémy, 83700 Saint-Raphaël, France
2269.aj: Calanque d'Anthéor, 90 Rte de Saint-Barthélémy, 83700 Saint-Raphaël, フランス

rv.t: Get here early, at least before 10, as the is limited parking. It's a great little beach that isn't very busy and fantastic for swimming. The slope out to sea is nice and gradual, and there are quite a few rocks and undersea features to encourage fish for good snorkeling.
Easy to access by car, train or bus, clean sandy beach to walk or swim. Bus stop and Train station Agay is 2 minutes by walk. restaurants and coffee shops are not far.
Small clean beach, a little crowded but good nevertheless. No lifeguards around. There are parking spots nearby so accessible by car.

2270.aj: Av. Jean Médecin, 06000 Nice, フランス
2270.ed: Scenic avenue renowned for its mix of global chains, a department store, a mall, boutiques & cafes.
2270.edj: 海外チェーン店や百貨店、モール、ブティック、カフェが並ぶ美しい大通り。

rv.t: Lively street in Nice with many shops. You can compare it to Vienna with Mariahilfer Street.
Beautiful street with a lot of shops, restaurants and coffee places
Street lined with the typical shops and cafes as well as a beautiful cathedral.

2271.a: Fontaine du Soleil, 3 Pl. Massena, 06300 Nice, France
2271.aj: Fontaine du Soleil, 3 Pl. Massena, 06300 Nice, フランス
2271.ed: Landmark bronze sculpture of Greek god Apollo, a focus of local jokes & anecdotes since the 1950s.
2271.edj: ギリシャ神話の神アポロンの有名な銅像がそびえる噴水。1950 年代の建造以来、地元ではジョークの種になり、紆余曲折を経ている。

rv.t: Visiting Fontaine du Soleil was honestly one of the highlights of walking through Nice, France 🇫🇷☀️✨ The fountain is absolutely stunning in person and the entire area around it has such an amazing atmosphere. Seeing the massive statue of Apollo standing in the centre surrounded by beautiful fountains and sculptures makes the whole square feel elegant and full of life. The location itself is perfect right in the…

Visiting Fontaine du Soleil was one of my favourite parts of exploring Nice. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by how beautiful the fountain is in person. The huge statue of Apollo standing in the middle, surrounded by elegant fountains and sculptures, really makes the whole square feel special. The location is perfect, right in the centre of the city and surrounded by lovely architecture, cafés, shops, and…

It was a nice stroll along the beach. Beautiful architecture There was a street market with fresh fruits and vegetables as well as a section for plants. If you need a public bathroom, be prepared to have a 50cent euro or free if you purchase in a local eatery

2272.a: Popeye Village, Triq Tal-Prajjet, Mellieħa, Malta
2272.aj: ポパイ村 Triq Tal-Prajjet, Mellieħa, マルタ
2272.ed: Film set from the 1980 musical 'Popeye', now a theme park village with boat rides & food outlets.
2272.edj: 1980 年公開のミュージカル映画「ポパイ」の舞台となった地。現在はボート乗り場や飲食店があるテーマパークとなっている。

rv.t: Popeye Village was one of the highlights of our family trip to Malta. Even if you’ve never watched the Popeye movie, the village is absolutely worth visiting. The colourful wooden houses, set against the turquoise waters of Anchor Bay, create a picture-perfect setting that feels like stepping into a storybook. What impressed me most was learning that this isn’t a replica—it is the original film set built for the…

Popeye Village is absolutely worth the drive, especially if you’re even remotely a cinema fan. Seeing the actual movie set built into the cliffs of Malta feels surreal, and honestly, you don’t even need to care about Popeye to appreciate how unique the entire place is. As a film producer, it’s honestly incredible to walk through and think about what they managed to accomplish here. The scale of the build, the…

We had a great time at Popeye Village. It’s a beautiful and unique place, especially for families with children. There are plenty of fun activities, and the atmosphere is very enjoyable. The scenery is stunning, making it a great spot for photos as well. One recommendation: if possible, avoid visiting during the summer. The weather was extremely hot, which made it less comfortable to explore and enjoy the…

2272.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:30

2273.aj: ブルーグロット Blue Grotto, マルタ
2273.ed: Accessible by boat trip, this natural attraction features a group of picturesque sea caves.
2273.edj: ボートでアクセスできる自然の観光スポット。美しい海の洞窟が複数ある。

rv.t: Absolutely stunning natural attraction! The Blue Grotto offers crystal-clear turquoise waters and impressive rock formations that look so much better in reality than in photos. The boat trip is short but definitely worth it for the views and the energy inside the caves. It’s best to visit early in the morning when the sunlight hits the water and creates amazing colors. A must-see spot in Malta!

The blue color of this Bay is incredible. I live in Spain at the Mediterranean Sea coast, but never seen this amazing color before. It’s better to take the whole view picture from the express way side (upper), then park the car at the beach parking, do down to the boat port. 10€ each adult. Valued price. Strong recommend

I’ve seen a lot of beautiful coastlines, but Blue Grotto really impressed me. The cliffs, the endless blue sea and the power of the waves make this place unforgettable. Photos don’t really capture how dramatic it feels when you’re standing there. Definitely one of the highlights of my trip to Malta.

2273.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:30

2274.a: 36HH+F9V Wied il-Għasri, Triq Is-Sagħtrija, Żebbuġ, Malta
2274.aj: 36HH+F9V Wied il-Għasri, Triq Is-Sagħtrija, Żebbuġ, マルタ
2274.ed: Swimming, snorkeling & hiking offered along a rocky coastal gorge with a turquoise river.

rv.t: Wied il-Għasri is a wonderful part of Gozo, with a dramatic, narrow valley leading to a secluded pebble beach. Is great for swimming but be careful at the rocks. It’s quite peaceful and wild compared to other popular spots, but the access involves a set of steep stairs, so be prepared for a bit of effort. It’s a good idea to bring water and a snack with you, as there’s only a small food truck that sells some…

Beautiful place. Totally free like most of the spots on Gozo. But you can’t see the whole beauty of it from the Valley. It looks even better from drone. I have it captured on my YouTube channel in the film from Gozo. Channel name: Ania &Greg Adventures

This secluded pebbled beach is a haven for those seeking to enjoy the Mediterranean in peace and quiet. The area sits between the town of Żebbuġ and Ġordan Hill. The sea here flows into the valley from between two beautiful cliffs. The area is great for snorkeling. The bottom of the pebbled beach can be accessed through a flight of steps.

2275.a: Pho 10 Ly Quoc Su, 10 P. Lý Quốc Sư, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2275.aj: Pho 10 Ly Quoc Su, 10 P. Lý Quốc Sư, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム
catj: フォー レストラン

rv.t: If you are visiting Hanoi Old Quarter, this place should be in your top choices to have a delicious meal. This restaurant is part of the Michelin Guide in Hanoi. The menu is simple, all the options available are Beef Pho with different type of meat: briskets, flank , well done, half done beef. We waited just 10 minutes to be seated and 10 more minutes to be served. The waited time was worth it. The flavor of the Pho…

I honestly thought this place was just another overhyped restaurant—but I was completely wrong. The pho here absolutely exceeded my expectations. The broth was incredibly rich and aromatic, the flavors were deep and well-balanced, and every ingredient came together perfectly. It’s easily one of the best bowls of pho I’ve had in Vietnam. Since it’s a Michelin-recognized restaurant, it’s no surprise that it gets very…

After a long, exhausting trek from Hanoi to Sapa and conquering the Fansipan peak, all I wanted was something comforting to bring me back to life. Enter Phở 10 Lý Quốc Sư, ordered via GrabFood. Honestly, I was worried about the broth arriving lukewarm, but their packaging is next-level. They use these sturdy, heat-sealed pouches that kept the soup piping hot, just like how it’s served in-shop. It was the perfect…

2276.a: The Note Coffee, 64 P. Lương Văn Can, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2276.aj: The Note Coffee, 64 P. Lương Văn Can, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2276.ed: Coffee & pastries served in a warm cafe known for colorful, customer-written notes lining the walls.
2276.edj: コーヒーとペストリーを提供する、温かみのあるカフェ。利用客のカラフルなメモ書きが一面に貼られている壁が有名。

rv.t: We tried the egg coffee, and for me, it was just average. If you're not a fan of the flavor or aroma of eggs, this might not be the drink for you. However, the café itself has a wonderful ambience. The creative wall art and unique décor make the place feel charming and artistic, creating a great atmosphere to relax, take photos, and enjoy the overall experience.

While exploring the streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter, I randomly came across The Note Coffee, which is just a short walk from Hoan Kiem Lake. I had actually seen this café in a few travel reels before my trip but had completely forgotten about it until I saw the colorful notes covering the building from outside. That's when I realized, this is the café everyone talks about. The café itself is quite small, but that's…

A very unique and charming café with a cozy atmosphere. I really liked the wall of sticky notes where customers can leave messages, and sitting by the window was a great spot to enjoy the street view. The food and drinks were decent but fairly average.

2276.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 8:00

2277.a: Pho Ga 26, 26 P. Lương Văn Can, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2277.aj: Pho Ga 26, 26 P. Lương Văn Can, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム
catj: フォー レストラン

rv.t: The best chicken pho that I ate in Hanoi. Very low price with high quality food. Don’t miss the dry pho, it tastes much better than the soup one. Sadly I visited this restaurant on my last day in Hanoi. If not, I will eat it everyday!

Love their "Pho Ga (Chicken Pho)" 😍 They have a Dry version (i.e. tossed in soy sauce) which I seldomly see and it's really good!!! I like the pho here so much I came once solo and brought a friend back for a second meal, really value-for-money 😚 If you don't like coriander you may want the Dry version because the soup might still have some coriander taste in it. The pho goes very well with a nice chilled bottle of…
Excellent tiny pho ga shop. I particularly like the dry pho ga here, with the soup served separately. The chicken is tender and very flavoursome. A great price too at 45k.

2278.a: Cau Go Vietnamese Cuisine, 9 Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
2278.aj: Cau Go Vietnamese Cuisine, 9 Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, ベトナム

rv.t: Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. The deep fried spring rolls were perfectly crispy, the fresh pork and shrimp spring rolls tasted so fresh and light, the sautéed baby clams with rice crackers were packed with flavour, and the grilled beef block was cooked beautifully. But the highlight of the meal was definitely the braised pork ribs with pepper — incredibly tender, rich, and full of flavour. Easily…

Visited this restaurant in Hanoi and overall had a great experience. It’s a bit tricky to find at first-it’s located across the road from the lake, but we couldn’t really identify a specific street entrance. There are actually entrances from both sides of the building, and the restaurant itself is inside, starting from around the 5th floor of a multi-level space. It felt like a place mostly visited by locals, which…

Fabulous. Of course the food was excellent. Sturgeon hot pot. But the servers (we had two) were truly exceptional. Truly. I tried once to pick up our wine bottle and they both bolted to our table. Watching sunset and the lights come up was especially nice. Far less expensive than Michelin in France. Highly recommend.

2278.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2279.a: Bancông Cafe & Restaurant, Số 2 P. Đinh Liệt, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam
2279.aj: Bancông Cafe & Restaurant, Số 2 P. Đinh Liệt, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000 ベトナム

rv.t: I can see why this café is so popular. I stopped by this morning for a fresh coconut, which cost 65,000 VND, and had a really lovely experience. The staff were warm, welcoming and courteous from the moment I arrived. I chose to sit upstairs on the balcony while it was raining, and it was incredibly relaxing. The balcony is filled with colourful flowers and greenery, making it a beautiful spot to watch the rain…

What a happy accident walking in to this restaurant. We saw the beautiful facade with the flowers and started taking photos and just happened to look at the menu to see what they have to offer. This place is a happy reprieve from the heat of walking along the old quarter. Food and drinks are amazing. With offerings for western palate. Will definitely recommend. An our server is also amazing!

So many wonderful things I could say about this lovely place. This is my first time traveling internationally and I did it solo! I saw glowing reviews on Google and TikTok haha and had to check it out. So glad I did! The service is great especially Quỳnh chi :) she is kind. I probably went to this place four times since it felt very comfortable and the menu is quite large. If you ever find yourself in the area…
